pretreatments.description: Sterilization by autoclaving with water for 30 min at 121 °C
pH adjustment to 7.0 ± 0.1 using 2 M hydrochloric acid
Enzymatic liquefaction using α-amylase (5000 units g starch−1) at 90 °C for one hour
pH adjustment to 5.2 ± 0.1 with sodium citrate buffer (25 mM)
Enzymatic saccharification using glucoamylase (334 units g starch−1) and cellulase (60 filter paper unit g cellulose−1) at 50 °C with mixing at 120 rpm for 24 h
Liquid hot water pretreatment in a stainless steel Parr reactor at 150 °C with pressurization using nitrogen gas for 5 min
